Extract console interactions into Ui
commitResults.messageBody: Move console input, separators, welcome and farewell messages, command errors, load errors, task-list displays, and mutation confirmations out of Bobby. Bobby now delegates all user-facing interaction to Ui while retaining the existing command-processing and persistence flow. This establishes a focused user-interface boundary without changing command behaviour, providing a safe base for later TaskList and Parser extractions.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor(OOP): Extract task list operations
commitResults.messageBody: Introduce TaskList as the owner of the application's in-memory task collection. It creates empty or loaded lists and supplies the add, remove, marking, lookup, count, and read-only snapshot operations previously performed directly on ArrayList in Bobby. Bobby remains responsible for command flow, persistence timing, and user feedback, keeping the extraction behaviour-preserving and creating a focused model boundary for the upcoming Parser extraction.

commitResults.messageTitle: refactor(OOP): Extract command parsing
commitResults.messageBody: Move command recognition, task-description parsing, date/time validation, task-number validation, and task construction from Bobby into Parser. Parser returns an immutable command object that states the requested operation and its task or selected index, allowing Bobby to focus on coordinating UI, task-list changes, and persistence. The existing command syntax and error messages are preserved.
